PROCESS CONTROL TABLES - AIR & WATER SERVICES (F24)
*SOFTWARE DEBOUNCE IS REQUIRED ON ALL DIGITAL INSTRUMENTS (NO HARDWARE DEBOUNCE)*

Pressure Band control of compressors. 
Refer to 24CM401_FP1 for the designation of the Duty Lead/Duty Lag/Standby compressors and associated pressure duty

ON = LEAD Pressure band
OFF = LAG Pressure band

Each compressor has two pressure bands settings that will be configured during commissioning
It triggers the load and unload
Remote Start/Stop function. This can only be enabled if Remote mode HS244497REM is Activated
Remote functionality to Start/Stop the controllers by digital input with Local Pressure Control (using Pressure Bands settings in the PLC as assigned by 24CM401_FP1)
